Accordingly, the Petitioner has prayed that the Commission may consider the above facts and condone the total delay due to the ROW issues faced by it as stated above. 22. . It is observed that due to such ROW issues, the implementation of Ckt-1 and Ckt-2 of the transmission line got delayed, and the present asset could only be commissioned on 2.8.2014 and 8.9.2014, respectively. It is noticed that the reasons detailed by the Petitioner are beyond the reasonable control of the Petitioner as the resolution of severe ROW issues that emerged during the implementation of the project required the involvement of the District Administration authorities, and due to the severity of the ROW issues, the matter had to be escalated to the Ministry of Power. We note that the Petitioner has also taken steps to mitigate the delay by coordinating with various authorities, having discussions and negotiations with the landowners etc., In our view, the delay on account of the aforesaid issues cannot be attributable to the Petitioner. Accordingly, the entire time over-run for Ckt-1 and Ckt-2 of the transmission line is condoned and the IDC and IEDC for the said delay are allowed. _(9) In case of dispute, any of the parties may make an application in accordance with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999, as amended from time to time, including statutory re-enactment thereof for settlement of the dispute:_
